behavior.arguments: rdi = struct pointer; byte at [rdi+0x15] is the tag, byte at [rdi+0xd40] is the confirmation for tag 3
behavior.branch_order: tag compared against 3 first (je to the confirmation path), then 4 (jne to ret); confirmation compared against 3 (jne to ret); each tail path adds to rdi before jumping

edges.tag_4: rdi += 0x20, tail jump to 0x1fa9a90, regardless of the confirmation byte

behavior.output_shape: no return value on tail paths (control never returns to the caller through this window); the ret path returns whatever eax held from the tag load (the tag byte, zero-extended) — no return-value meaning is claimed
behavior.rule: byte [rdi+0x15] == 3 and byte [rdi+0xd40] == 3: rdi += 0x60, jmp 0x1fabc20; byte [rdi+0x15] == 4: rdi += 0x20, jmp 0x1fa9a90; else: ret

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase
